frank: FYI during magnet-13b-int4 bring-up I found a reproducible KV index wobble when resuming at ~12k tokens. Minimal repro below.

maya: what do you mean by wobble? output corruption or timing?

frank: tokens look correct for a bit then subsequences repeat/out-of-order. traced it to RoPE index calculation flipping to a lower window at resume. Seems like we applied a tile-base that forgot to add the resume offset.

maya: repro command?

frank:
```bash
./redwood-smoke --model magnet-13b:rev2 --quant int4-packed --context 12288 \\n  --resume-from ckpt.2026-03-18 --enable-kv-cache --rope-rescale=adaptive \\n  --seed 7 --input tests/long_chat.txt
```

dev-bot: run 5098765432 queued (smoke: quant-resume)

frank: trimmed logs: 
```
[RESUME] resume_pos=12288 attach_base=11264
[KV] mapped_slot=5120 -> kv_index=11264
[ATTN] tok=11011 pos_scaled=11011 rot_phase=0x5c
[ATTN] tok=64 pos_scaled=64 rot_phase=0x5c  # expected pos 12288+64
```

maya: +11524 delta looks like chunk truncation. Which memcpy kernel runs for int4-packed? New stride kernel?

frank: yes, int4-packed uses packed-memcpy-v2 that does 32-byte compressed copies. I suspect it masks high bits when aligning to 32B boundaries. fp16/int8 paths use standard cudaMemcpy and don't show this.

maya: can you try `--kv-zero-fill=true` on resume so memcpy won't rely on stale header bits? Also try `--rope-rescale=none` to see if rescale is amplifying.

frank: tried both: `--kv-zero-fill=true` prevents the immediate repeat (so zeroing hides it) and `--rope-rescale=none` delays divergence but doesn't fix mapping mismatch. So root cause is index truncation during memcpy/pack.

sre-bot: incident-note created: IN-2026-042 (kv-resume-wobble)

maya: action: add micro unit that simulates a resume at chunk boundary (context 12288) exercising packed-memcpy-v2. Compare output buffer bytes between packed path and fp16 path. I'll own this.

frank: I'll drop a tiny reproducer and include hexdumps around the KV header and the pos indices. Also ran a small quality sweep (3 seeds) vs fp16: fp16=1.00, int8=0.996, int4-packed=0.955 with mismatch observed in 2/3 seeds when resume path triggered.

maya: file a PR with failing unit + attach nvprof trace for memcpy alignment. Tag me and @sre on it.

frank: opened PR link in thread (internal) with repro and hexdumps.

dev-bot: PR created (kv-packed-resume-fail) "+1" assigned to maya

maya: nice find. We'll also add a bring-up checklist item: "resume integrity under quant-packed memcpy". If we can't fix kernel quickly, gate packed-memcpy behind a resume-safety flag.

frank: agreed. I'll follow up with the small binary and perf numbers for rebase vs no-rebase. Thanks.
